jobs.title: Night Hospital Security Officer - Visitor & Access Control
jobs.description:
Texas Children's Hospital in Houston is seeking a full-time night shift NCSO Security Officer to maintain a safe environment for patients, visitors and staff.

You will staff posts, monitor access, document logs, and respond to emergencies, working as a visible deterrent and coordinating with security leadership.

Candidates should have a High School diploma, BLS, NCSO and Texas Driver's License, with a year of security or related experience.

jobs.title: Night-Shift Surveillance Officer: Detect Threats & Protect
jobs.description:
GardaWorld Security Services in Houston is seeking a Surveillance Security Officer to monitor security systems, identify threats, and document incidents with precise reports.

The role offers a fixed Thursday–Monday night schedule, a $16.00 hourly wage, and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) with employer matching, PTO, holidays, disability coverage, and life insurance. Uniforms are provided.

jobs.title: Night-Shift Security Officer: Parking Patrol & Training
jobs.description:
United Protective Services is seeking an Overnight Security Officer in Houston, TX, for a full-time, on-site role. The officer will patrol parking areas, perform rover checks, report incidents, and assist tenants while maintaining a visible security presence.

Ideal candidates have prior security experience, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work independently on night shifts with reliable transportation.
